claim_text: Baseline candidate generator produces high-quality masks even when final F1=0
allowed_wording: Baseline candidate generation produced high-quality whole-plant candidate masks (raw oracle F1 = 0.9867-0.9882) even on frames where final F1 = 0.
forbidden_wording: P6/candidate generation failed; no correct candidate existed; P6 could not detect the plant
notes: From Phase18_evidence_registry.csv (source commit 26da29e6). Maps to the NEW ranking-failure Results section; Phase18 Figure_A 5-panel rows show RGB/GT/R0 wrong/oracle/R1.

claim_text: Identified catastrophic failures caused by candidate ranking not generation
allowed_wording: Catastrophic failures (DouBanLv2 0039-0041) were caused by candidate-ranking failure (selected distractor), not candidate generation (C3_RANKING_FAILURE).
forbidden_wording: Failure caused by prompt/candidate-generation failure; P6 prompt failed; P6 failed to detect DouBanLv2 0039-0041
notes: From Phase18_evidence_registry.csv. Central narrative for Results §3.3; supported by Phase17B_detection_diagnosis.csv.

claim_text: q_contrast can favor small high-contrast distractor masks
allowed_wording: q_contrast can favor small, high-contrast distractor masks over larger whole-plant candidates (failure-frame Spearman rho = -0.7187 p = 0.0038; contrast-drop ablation rescued 3/3 identified failures).
forbidden_wording: q_contrast is the proven/global/sole cause of ranking failures; q_contrast always favors distractors
notes: From Phase18_evidence_registry.csv. Mechanism wording must stay correlational (SUPPORTED not PROVEN).

claim_text: Removing q_contrast from primary ranking eliminates identified DEV-set ranking failures
allowed_wording: Removing q_contrast from the primary ranking (R1) eliminated all identified DEV-set ranking failures (0039/0040/0041 rescued to F1 >= 0.95) with zero material regressions on Easy21.
forbidden_wording: R1 significantly improves general segmentation performance; R1 proven superior globally
notes: From Phase18_evidence_registry.csv. Report as rescue on the identified DEV set; no global superiority claim.

claim_text: R1 significantly improves general segmentation performance
allowed_wording: R1 was selected for failure-rescue, zero material regression, low selection churn, and structural simplicity - not because its mean F1 is significantly higher (N=10 mean-F1 comparisons are descriptive only).
forbidden_wording: R1 significantly/statistically significantly improves/generalizes/outperforms the baseline
notes: FORBIDDEN claim - must NOT appear as stated. Only the allowed_wording (selection rationale) may be used. C05 flagged FORBIDDEN in the Phase19B rewrite checklist.

claim_text: A6 cross-view consensus provides consistent improvements
allowed_wording: A6 (cross-view consensus) did not provide consistent measurable benefit under the evaluated settings (E_A6 ≈ -0.003; one material regression ΔF1 = -0.058 on ChangShouHua2_0075).
forbidden_wording: A6 improves/consistently benefits segmentation; A6 retained as production default

claim_text: A7 memory propagation provides consistent improvements
allowed_wording: A7 (memory propagation) was empirically near-neutral (E_A7 ≈ 0) under valid execution exposure (13 propagated / 9 selected of 21 frames on Easy21); one marginal GT10 improvement (ΔF1 = +0.006).
forbidden_wording: A7 improves segmentation; A7 neutral based on the invalid 0-propagation observation
notes: From Phase18_evidence_registry.csv. Must cite the Phase14.1 corrected exposure, not the invalid Phase14 zero-propagation observation.

claim_text: A6/A7 retained as default production enhancements (claim is FALSE)
allowed_wording: A6 and A7 are optional experimental branches, disabled by default; not retained as default production enhancements.
forbidden_wording: A6/A7 are part of the production default pipeline; A6/A7 provide consistent benefit
notes: From Phase18_evidence_registry.csv. Production defaults: --use_cross_view_consensus False, --use_memory_propagation False.

claim_text: RAP-FSAM3 segmentation quality on frozen P6 evaluation frames (F1=0.9706, mIoU=0.9641, HD95=183.42 px, Boundary-F1=0.4643, leakage energy=0.001739)
allowed_wording: RAP-FSAM3 achieved F1=0.9706, mIoU=0.9641, HD95=183.42 px, Boundary-F1=0.4643, leakage energy=0.001739 on the manually annotated evaluation frames sampled from all 20 RGB sequences.
forbidden_wording: RAP-FSAM3 significantly outperforms single-prompt SAM3; statistically significant improvement; outperforming [unqualified]
notes: Paper-level claim from ForeSplat.tex abstract + Table 3. Values are descriptive means over the frozen annotated set; F1/mIoU deltas vs SAM3 (0.9706 vs 0.9692) are within annotation variance - no significance test, no 'outperforming'.

claim_text: RAP-FSAM3 improvement over single-prompt SAM3 is concentrated in boundary consistency and leakage suppression
allowed_wording: Improvements over single-prompt SAM3 were concentrated in boundary consistency (Boundary-F1 0.4643 vs 0.4051) and leakage suppression (leakage energy 0.001739 vs 0.002272); region-overlap deltas (F1 0.9706 vs 0.9692, mIoU 0.9641 vs 0.9624) were small.
forbidden_wording: outperforming single-prompt SAM3 and other automatic VFM baselines particularly in boundary consistency and leakage suppression [unqualified 'outperforming']
notes: Paper-level claim from ForeSplat.tex abstract (claim_audit row: SUPPORTED with rewording). 'Outperforming' must be replaced by specific metric deltas.

claim_text: Direct VFM prompting is semantically fragile in potted-plant scenes (prompt robustness)
allowed_wording: The plant-instance prompt was the most stable direct prompt (F1=0.9692); green-region 0.7972 (green-background inclusion), organ-level 0.6471 (under-recall), seedling-oriented 0.0768 (near-empty on mature plants), background-excluding 0.4051 (over-conservative). Single-prompt VFM segmentation is semantically fragile in potted-plant scenes.
forbidden_wording: single-prompt VFM segmentation is robust; the prompt set generalises to all scenes
notes: Paper-level claim from ForeSplat.tex §3.2 / Table 4. F1 values are per-prompt means on the frozen annotated set; descriptive only.

claim_text: RAP-FSAM3 module ablation shows semantic-gated selection prevents geometry-only selector failure
allowed_wording: Geometry-only multi-prompt selector degraded F1 to 0.8429 (semantically inappropriate candidates); semantic gating recovered the stable plant-instance prompt (0.9692); SB-FBPR improved boundary/leakage; full RAP-FSAM3 w/ GCFC 0.9706.
forbidden_wording: module ablation proves SG-MPS necessary in all settings; SB-FBPR/GCFC each provide statistically significant gain
notes: Paper-level claim from ForeSplat.tex §3.3 / Table 5. Rows are descriptive ablation values on the frozen set; geometry-only row must be framed as diagnostic.

claim_text: 2DGS reconstruction quality on 20-sequence workflow validation (PSNR=31.09, SSIM=0.9711, LPIPS=0.0365)
allowed_wording: ForeSplat achieved PSNR=31.09 dB, SSIM=0.9711, LPIPS=0.0365 under the unified 20-sequence protocol; +1.51 dB vs standard 2DGS (29.58); reduced train/recon time 60.94% and meshing time 65.17% vs standard 2DGS; meshing 55 s vs 642 s for 3DGS+preproc.
forbidden_wording: ForeSplat significantly improves reconstruction quality; statistically significant PSNR/SSIM gain; state-of-the-art reconstruction
notes: Paper-level claim from ForeSplat.tex §3.5 / Table 7. Values are workflow-level means over 20 sequences; application-level comparison, not a pure loss-function ablation; descriptive only.

claim_text: Foreground-object loss injection is necessary for foreground-object 2DGS (injection-position ablation)
allowed_wording: Full-scene 2DGS had outside-mask non-black ratio 0.9908 and leakage 1.2201; input masking dropped PSNR_fg 24.21->20.73; foreground-object loss injection reduced outside ratio to 0.0294 and leakage to 0.0190; post hoc mask pruning left outside 0.7509 / leakage 0.7900.
forbidden_wording: input masking or post hoc pruning is sufficient; foreground-object injection is not necessary; significant test implied
notes: Paper-level claim from ForeSplat.tex §3.4 / Table 6. Single-sample representative ablation (1 sequence); descriptive; post hoc pruning must be described as insufficient, not 'useless'.

claim_text: Virtual vs manual phenotypic trait agreement (R2 = 0.988/0.988/0.974/0.900)
allowed_wording: Virtual measurements were comparable to manual measurements: plant height R2=0.988 (MAE 0.98 cm), canopy width R2=0.988 (MAE 0.86 cm), leaf length R2=0.974 (MAE 0.51 cm, n=63), leaf width R2=0.900 (MAE 0.45 cm).
forbidden_wording: strong agreement; virtual measurements are accurate/superior; statistically validated agreement; R2 proves measurement accuracy
notes: Paper-level claim from ForeSplat.tex §3.5 / Table 8. 'Strong agreement' forbidden (claim_audit: 'comparable to' is the honest wording); n=21 plant-level, n=63 leaf-level, no repeated measurements, no Bland-Altman.

claim_text: A6/A7 negative ablation (both DEMOTED, default OFF)
allowed_wording: A6 and A7 did not provide consistent measurable benefit under the evaluated settings; both are disabled by default (--use_cross_view_consensus False, --use_memory_propagation False).
forbidden_wording: A6/A7 improve segmentation; A6/A7 are part of the production default pipeline; A6/A7 provide consistent benefit
notes: Paper-level claim consolidating C06-C08 into the negative-ablation narrative. Must appear only as negative/limitation result; do NOT add A6/A7 to the main Method (method_component_audit G11 PASS).
